home1.text: Long day. Carol’s going to have my head for that landing.

home2.text: Ten minutes. I just need ten minutes.

keys.text: Keys on the table, like a grown-up.

photo1.text: Dad. Martin Jordan. Best test pilot Ferris Aircraft ever had.

posters.text: Every kid on the base wanted to fly. I was the one who never stopped.

window.text: Storm’s rolling in off the lake.

dad1.text: Keep your eyes on the sky, Hal. When I come around, I’ll tip my wings for you.

dad2.text: Promise. Nothing up there to be scared of.

halMemory.text: I was eight. That night I decided I would never be afraid of anything again.

hal1.text: Wh— who’s there? What is this?

light2.text: The ring has crossed the stars to find you.

light3.text: It seeks one with the will to overcome great fear.

lightAgain.text: Look inside yourself, Hal Jordan. Answer again.

halHurt.text: You’re hurt. Don’t move — I’ll get help.

halConfused.text: I can’t understand you. I don’t know what you want.

abin3.text: Now you understand me. The ring speaks every tongue.

abin4.text: It chooses those who can overcome great fear. You have that will, Hal Jordan.

abin5.text: I am Abin Sur. I guarded this sector of space. Sector two eight one four.

abin6.text: Take the lantern. Speak the oath. And be… worthy of it.

oath1.text: In brightest day, in blackest night,

oath2.text: No evil shall escape my sight.

oath3.text: Let those who worship evil’s might

oath4.text: Beware my power — Green Lantern’s light!

ringPocket.text: The power battery can be kept in the ring’s pocket dimension until it is needed.

halPocket.text: A pocket dimension. Of course there is.

halFly.text: Nothing up here to be scared of. You were right, Dad.

ringBond.text: Bearer accepted. Power reserve: twelve percent. Recharge at the power battery.

ringOnline.text: Construct interface online. The ring gives your will a shape.

ringCore.text: Warning: the vessel’s power core is failing.

ringBreach.text: Opening a breach to the antimatter universe. Qward.

ringHurt.text: Bearer injured. Raise the shield toward the threat.

ringWall.text: Barrier constructs hold for twenty seconds.

ringDone.text: Training complete. Recharge at the power battery every twenty-four hours, or when the light runs low.

ringOffline.text: Construct interface offline. Recharge at the power battery.

ringLowCharge.text: Insufficient charge. Recharge at the power battery.

ringSummons.text: Priority transmission from Oa, for the bearer of Abin Sur’s ring.

guardian1.text: Hal Jordan of Earth. The ring of Abin Sur has chosen you.

guardian2.text: Come to Oa, and learn what it is to be a Green Lantern.

ringCourse.text: Sector zero, at the centre of the universe. Course plotted. Climb, and I will take you there.

halAbin.text: Rest easy, Abin Sur. I’ll take it from here.

ringClimb.text: Altitude sufficient. Ready for the jump.

ringOrbitEarth.text: Leaving Sector zero. Course locked: Earth, Sector 2814.

ringOrbitYsmault.text: Leaving Sector 2814. Course locked: Ysmault, Sector 666.

halEarth.text: Dad would have given anything to see this.

kwEarth.text: And poozer: Sector 2814 still needs its Lantern. Go home when you’re needed. The ring knows the way.

ringRoutes.text: Hyperspace routes charted: Earth and Oa. Fly high and press E to set a course.

ringHigher.text: Climb higher to make the jump.

kwBack.text: Back already, poozer? The range is yours.

ringAbin.text: Abin Sur’s remains have been carried home to Oa by the Corps.

ringOa.text: Oa. Sector zero. Central Power Battery in range: recharging continuously.

kwIntro1.text: So you’re Abin Sur’s pick. A human.

kwIntro2.text: Kilowog. Every rookie who comes to Oa comes through me, and most of them wash out. Till I say otherwise, you’re a poozer.

kwIntro3.text: Means you’re new. Means you’re mine. Targets are up. Break ’em.

kwFire1.text: Fists are for bar fights. Out there, things shoot back, and they don’t line up to be punched.

kwFire2.text: You need reach. Picture a cannon. Every barrel, every round. If you can see it, the ring can make it.

kwLive.text: Live fire, poozer. These ones bite.

kwShield.text: Shield! You’ve got one. Use it!

kwCover.text: You’re bleeding light. Get behind something!

kwRange.text: The range is yours. Come see me when you want another round.

sin1.text: Kilowog. So this is the human Abin Sur’s ring chose.

sin2.text: Abin Sur was my friend. His ring deserved better than a brawler from a backwater world.

sin3.text: Fists and cannons. Crude. A construct is a thought, held still. Watch.

sinDrones.text: Adequate. Now try it against someone who thinks.

sinQ2.text: Fear. The one weapon they would never let us use.

sinQ3.text: I can feel it. Every fear on Korugar, like a hand round a throat.

sinEnd2.text: You fight like a man who has never once considered that he might lose.

sinEnd3.text: Fearless is not the same as wise. We will continue, rookie.

kwLikes.text: He likes you, poozer. That’s as warm as he gets.

kwGuardians.text: Now get moving. The Guardians want to see you. Their hall, out toward the battery. And don’t make me look bad.

ringHall.text: Summons received: the Guardians of the Universe. Course laid in to their hall.

gHall1.text: Hal Jordan of Earth. Stand before us.

gHall2.text: Abin Sur served the Corps since before your world raised its first city. In his last hour his ring went searching, and it found you.

gHall3.text: No human has worn the ring before. Your kind is young, and quick to fear.

sinHall1.text: Then let it pass to one who has earned it. Sector 2814 was his. It deserves more than whoever stood nearest when he fell.

gHall4.text: The ring does not choose in error, Sinestro. It sought one who could overcome great fear.

halHall1.text: I didn’t ask for this. He did, with his last breath. I’m not giving it back.

gRite.text: Abin Sur of Ungara. Your light returns to the light.

gHall6.text: Hal Jordan. Sector 2814 is yours to guard. Return to your world, and keep it.

ring2814.text: Sector 2814 assigned. Green Lantern Hal Jordan.

sinHall2.text: Wear his ring well, human. I will be watching.

ringHome.text: Course plotted: Sector 2814, Earth. Climb, and make the jump.

halBack.text: Four in the morning. The Air Force test is at nine. Three hours. I can do three hours.

ringMorning.text: Good morning, Lantern Jordan. Sector 2814: no threats detected.

vmTom1.text: Hal, it’s Tom. Where are you, man? The Air Force guys are here, the bird’s fuelled, and Carol’s doing the thing with her pen. Call me.

vmTom2.text: Okay. They scrubbed it. Hammond’s people just drove off. I don’t know where you were last night, buddy, but you’d better have one hell of a story.

vmCarol.text: Hal. It’s Carol. Come in. We need to talk.

vmLandlord.text: Mr. Jordan, Sal Delgado. Rent was due on the first. That makes two months. I need it by Friday, or I start the paperwork. Have a nice day.

halMorning.text: I flew across the universe last night. And I still can’t make a nine o’clock.

fridge.text: Ketchup. Half a lemon. Something that used to be milk.

bills1.text: Past due. Past due. Final notice.

bills2.text: The electric company has started using red ink. That seems personal.

photoMorning.text: He never missed a flight in his life.

windowMorning.text: Storm’s gone. Coast City looks like nothing happened last night.

notice.text: “Notice to pay rent or quit. Seventy-two hours.” He slid it under the door. Classy, Sal.

halDoor.text: Okay. Keys, wallet, ring. Let’s go get yelled at.

halDrive.text: Hammond came out from Edwards for this. Carol’s been chasing that contract for a year.

halFerris.text: Dad flew out of this field for twenty years. This is the first morning I didn’t want to be here.

carol1.text: You’re late, Hal. About an hour and a half late.

carol2.text: Then explain. General Hammond flew in from Edwards. His engineers stood on that runway and watched an empty cockpit for forty minutes.

carol3.text: So go on. Where were you?

carol5.text: My father hired you because of yours. I’ve covered for you every time you pulled something like this. The barrel roll at the air show. The landing last night. Every time.

carol6.text: Not this time. You’re grounded, Hal. You’re done at Ferris. Clean out your locker.

ringAfter.text: Lantern Jordan, your heart rate is elevated. No threat detected.

halAfter2.text: No job. Two months behind on rent. And a ring that talks.

halAfter3.text: You’d have laughed at this, Dad.

tomCall1.text: You’re still out there? I can see your car from the hangar, Hal. Listen. Hammond’s not flying home empty-handed. They put his own guy in the bird. Wheels up at two.

tomCall2.text: Some captain from Edwards. Never flown her. Carol signed off on it twenty minutes ago.

tomCall3.text: Go home, buddy. You don’t want to watch this.

halTest.text: She was supposed to be mine.

ringDistress.text: Aircraft in distress. One life aboard.

pilotMayday.text: Mayday, mayday, Viper One-One. Lost the left engine. I’ve got a fire light, she’s not answering. I can’t hold her.

pilotGear.text: I’m… something’s got me. I’m being carried. Gear’s down. Gear’s down!

ringField.text: Not here. Bring it over the field.

pilotDown.text: Ferris tower, Viper One-One is on the ground. I don’t… I don’t know how.

carolGL2.text: You caught a fighter jet. With your… hand.

techWreck1.text: Doctor Hammond, the general said nobody touches it till the team from Edwards gets here.

hecWreck1.text: The general says a great many things.

techThought1.text: …always was a freak. The old man only keeps him on out of pity…

hecArrive2.text: And you. Such loud thoughts, under that mask. Frightened little thoughts.

hecArrive3.text: Doctor Hector Hammond. The general’s son. The disappointment. They sent me to look at a ship in a lake last night, and it looked back.

hecArrive4.text: The pilot was so afraid. I only helped him along.

hecArrive5.text: Oh, I don’t think she will.

hecQ1.text: I can feel you aiming, you know.

hecWave.text: Listen to it. All of it.

ringProtect.text: Target is shielding himself. Break it.

hecMind1.text: No. No, I’m in now. An airfield. A little boy watching the sky. His father’s plane coming down.

sinFerris2.text: Ganthet sent me to learn how Abin Sur died. I did not expect to find his successor on his knees before a man with a swollen head.

sinFerris3.text: I said I would be watching.

sinFerris4.text: Abin Sur’s ship did not fall from the sky by chance, human. Its hold was a prison cell. The cell is empty.

sinFerris5.text: Something that hates us. Rest while you can. Your people are coming, and they should not find you here.

halGraveWay.text: All the way down the path. Under the two cypresses, by the bench.

halGrave2.text: I got fired today. Caught a jet with my hand. A guy with a big head read my mind. Long day.

halGrave3.text: There’s something out there. The one who knows says it hates us.

halGrave4.text: I used to tell you I wasn’t scared of anything.

halPilot0.text: She called at seven. She never calls at seven.

carolP2.text: The Air Force wants the test flown again. After yesterday, their man won’t go near that cockpit, and nobody else here will either.

carolP3.text: General Hammond went home without a word. His son is in an Air Force hospital, and no one will tell me why.

carolP4.text: So. You’re my pilot again. On probation. Don’t make me regret it.

carolP6.text: And whoever that was on my runway yesterday: if you ever see him, tell him thank you.

ringSinCall.text: Lantern Sinestro requests you at Abin Sur’s vessel.

sinCell2.text: Look at his ship, Jordan. Properly. Tell me what you see.

ringClueBlood.text: Organic residue. Species unknown. It is still burning.

ringClueGlyph.text: Script of Ysmault, cut into stone. It reads: rage.

halCell2.text: He wasn’t alone in there. Somebody was locked up, and they got out.

sinCell3.text: Abin Sur was carrying a prisoner to Oa. Atrocitus of Ysmault, one of the Five Inversions. The last of Sector 666, after the Manhunters came.

sinCell4.text: Machines. The Guardians’ first police, before the Corps. They killed every living thing in his sector but five. He has hated the Guardians, and every one of us who wears their light, for a very long time.

sinCell5.text: He broke out of that cell, and he killed Abin Sur. The crash only finished it.

ringTrail.text: Residue trail detected. Bearing west. Coast City.

sinCell6.text: Your city, Lantern. Lead the way.

atroSite1.text: Two of them. The Guardians’ dogs come in pairs now.

atroSite2.text: I smelled Abin Sur’s light on you, little human. I wondered who had taken it from his corpse.

sinSite1.text: Atrocitus. By the authority of the Guardians of the Universe, you are under arrest.

atroSite3.text: The Guardians. Let them come. Let them all come.

atroQ1.text: Is that the best your ring can do?

atroQ2.text: I bathed in the blood of my world. You will not stop me.

atroCover.text: Your light cannot touch me, Lantern.

sinQGun.text: He sees your gun coming, Jordan. Wait until he commits.

sinQFlank.text: He has turned on me. His side, Jordan!

sinQSite.text: Keep him moving, Jordan. Don’t let him close.

sinQWall.text: A wall, Jordan. Let him run into it.

atroDrain.text: Your little lights. I know how to put them out.

sinDrain1.text: Your lantern, Jordan! Call it out of the pocket. Now!

atroExcavator.text: Die under the Earth you love, Korugarian.

atroBind1.text: Nothing is over. Not for me. Not for you.

sinBind2.text: I will take him to Ysmault. He can rot with the others.

halDevice.text: His machine. It was right here.

ringYsmault.text: Ysmault. Sector 666. No life signs on the surface.

sinYs1.text: The Inversions were chained here when the Manhunters had done their work. The Guardians thought it mercy.

atroYs2.text: Hear me, Lantern. The Blackest Night is coming. The dead will rise, and every light in the universe will go out.

atroYs3.text: And you, Korugarian. I see your world in chaos, and you at the heart of it. You will burn with a rage like mine.

sinYs3.text: To Oa, Jordan. The Guardians will want to see us both.

gTrial1.text: Hal Jordan of Sector 2814. Sinestro of Sector 1417.

gTrial2.text: You acted together on Earth without our leave. A Lantern keeps to his own sector. The charge is disorderly conduct.

halTrial1.text: He was right. Atrocitus was in my city. We stopped him.

gTrial3.text: You did. The prisoner is returned, and the Corps has lost no one else. The charge is set aside.

gTrial4.text: Sinestro. You will watch over Jordan’s training in the field.

sinTrial2.text: The next time we meet, Jordan, it will be on Korugar. Try not to embarrass me.

radio1.text: Seven-ten on a Tuesday, sunny and eighty-one in Coast City. And everybody is still talking about the man in green at Ferris Aircraft.

radio2.text: I saw it from the highway! He caught a fighter jet. With his hand! A green hand!

radio3.text: The Air Force says no comment. Ferris Aircraft says no comment. My mother says he’s an angel. Lines are open.

halRadio.text: For the car. The Phoenix’s radio only gets the weather.

salDoor1.text: Jordan! I can hear your radio, so don’t tell me you’re out. Friday. Two months, Friday.

halSal1.text: Sal, I’ve got my job back. First paycheck’s in two weeks.

salDoor2.text: Then you’ve got two weeks to find two months. Friday, Jordan.

halSal2.text: Great. Saved a jet, can’t save the rent.

photoTuesday.text: First day back on the line, Dad. Try not to watch.

radioOff.text: That’s enough fame for one morning.

carFirst.text: Huh. First try. Somebody up there likes me.

radio4.text: More calls on the green man. Barbara in Sun Valley says he waved at her. Barbara, I think he waves at everybody.

halPark.text: Seven fifty-eight. On time. Write it down somewhere.

halDent.text: That’s coming out of somebody’s paycheck. Probably mine.

halTown.text: Out of town, out to the desert road.

halAdv1.text: Carol. Got a minute? It’s about payday.

carolAdv1.text: You’ve been back for three days, Hal.

halAdv2.text: My landlord’s been counting a lot longer than that. Two months.

carolAdv2.text: Give me his number. Accounts will pay him today.

carolAdv3.text: You can. It comes out of your probation. Every hour you fly for me until it’s paid, you fly for free. Still want it?

halAdv4.text: Best deal I’ve had all week.

carolAdv5.text: Suit up. The prototype’s fuelled. Climb, a high-g turn, a supersonic run for the Air Force, a pass for their cameras, and you bring it home in one piece.

tower1.text: Ferris Two-Seven, wind calm, runway two-seven, cleared for takeoff. Don’t break my airplane.

tower2.text: Gear up, Jordan. Climb to one-two thousand and level off.

tower3.text: Level at twelve. Give me the turn. Five g, and hold it.

tower4.text: Good turn. The Air Force wants Mach one point two. Light the burners.

tower5.text: That’s the number. They heard that in Coast City.

tower6.text: Now the pass. Low over the field, past the tower, for their cameras. Low, Jordan, not stupid.

tower7.text: Jordan! That was the tower’s windows you nearly took with you!

tower8.text: Bring it home. Runway two-seven. Gear down.

tower9.text: Welcome back to Ferris, Hal. Nice flying.

towerRange.text: Two-Seven, you’re leaving the range. Turn back toward the field.

towerGear.text: Your gear’s still up, Jordan. Put the wheels down.

jetCrash.text: Two-Seven, do you read? Hal! Hal, answer me!

carolPick1.text: The Air Force signed off on all of it. Even the pass. Good first day, Jordan.

halPick1.text: Good enough for dinner? Strictly as your employee.

carolPick3.text: But you know who I would have dinner with? The man on my runway. Whoever he is.

carolPick4.text: Hal? Who is that? He knows you?

halPick2.text: Sinestro, this isn’t a good time.

sinPick2.text: It is the Guardians’ time, not yours. Or have you forgotten whose ring that is?

halPick3.text: Carol. I’m sorry. I should have told you.

carolPick5.text: It was you. On my runway. You caught my airplane.

carolPick6.text: You idiot. You absolute idiot. You could have told me.

carolPick7.text: Go. And come back, Hal Jordan. I’m not done with you.

ringOrbitKorugar.text: Leaving Sector 2814. Course locked: Korugar, Sector 1417.

ringApproachKorugar.text: Orbital approach. Korugar, Sector 1417. Population nine point two billion.

sinKor1.text: People of Korugar. Seven years ago, this was a city of thieves. Riots in the streets, the markets burning.

sinKor2.text: Look at it now. There is not a lock on a door in the capital. Not a child out after dark. Order is peace.

halKor1.text: They love him. Look at them. A whole world.

sinKor3.text: Seven years without a murder, Jordan. Can your Coast City say that?

halKor2.text: Coast City can’t go seven days.

sinKor4.text: Then watch, and learn what a Lantern is for.

ringKor.text: Korugarian language: translating. Translation is literal.

sinStaff1.text: A fist breaks. A blade kills. When you must move a crowd and leave it standing, you use a staff.

sinStaff2.text: The drones. Put them down. Sweep, do not strike.

sinStaff3.text: Adequate. Now walk my market. See what order looks like.

kv1a.text: Glory to Sinestro, Lantern. Glory to the light.

kv2a.text: We are safe, Lantern. Thanks to him.

halKv2.text: They step back from the ring. From me. The same ring.

halKv4.text: They’re terrified of him. Of us.

guard1.text: You. You laughed when the Lantern passed.

korTaken.text: No! I didn’t, I swear, I was only—

sinTaken1.text: He laughed, Jordan. At order. It begins with laughter.

halTaken2.text: You’re locking people up for laughing?

sinTaken2.text: I am keeping them from what comes after it. I have a city to run. Patrol the old quarter, and come to the palace at dusk.

halQuarter.text: Somebody’s been following me since the market.

katma1.text: Not another step, Lantern. I know what that ring does.

halKatma1.text: Easy. I’m Hal Jordan. Sector 2814. I’m new.

katma2.text: Sinestro’s new apprentice. I know. Everyone in the quarter knows.

katma3.text: Katma Tui. These are what’s left of us. On Korugar, a green ring means the cells.

katma4.text: The Halls of Correction. Four thousand people. For laughing. For praying. For asking where their families went.

katma5.text: Look at the bars, Lantern. Whose light is that?

halKatma3.text: His. Every cell in there is held shut by his ring.

katma6.text: They love him in the plaza because the plaza has walls with ears. Here, we only love each other.

korRebel.text: Drones! Security drones, over the wall! They followed him here!

katma7.text: Into the doorways! Lantern, if you are not his, now is when you show it.

katma8.text: You fought his drones. In front of the whole quarter. He will know by now.

sinRep1.text: So. My apprentice, defending traitors in a back street.

halRep1.text: They’re not traitors. They’re scared. Your whole world is scared of you.

sinRep2.text: Fear is the beginning of order, Jordan. You have never once been afraid. They have. That is why they obey.

halRep2.text: That’s not order. That’s a cage, and you’re holding the door shut with the Corps’ light.

sinRep3.text: Then go and tell the Guardians. Tell them everything. They will thank me for it.

katma9.text: Lantern. If you are going to Oa, do not come back with only words.

ringOaJump.text: Fly high and make the jump. Course: Oa.

gRep1.text: Hal Jordan. You have left the side of the Lantern who trains you.

halRep4.text: I came to tell you what he’s done with Korugar. He rules it. Prisons barred with his ring’s light. People taken for laughing.

gRep2.text: Sinestro has kept Sector 1417 without a single loss for seven years.

halRep5.text: Because everyone’s too afraid to breathe. You gave him the light to fight fear with, and he’s using it to make fear.

gRep3.text: A Lantern may not rule. That is the oldest law of the Corps.

gRep4.text: We will hear Sinestro of Korugar. Bring him to Oa.

halDawn0.text: Lights on in Hangar Two. Six in the morning.

carolDawn1.text: You said you’d come back. You didn’t say when.

carolDawn2.text: I sent everybody home and sat in that cockpit, counting how many times you’ve lied to me this week.

halDawn2.text: I didn’t lie. I just left a lot out.

carolDawn3.text: The man on my runway. A jet that came down in one piece. Whatever happened to Hector Hammond.

carolDawn5.text: And where did he take you, the one with the moustache?

halDawn5.text: A planet called Korugar. Nine billion people, and every one of them is terrified of him. So I told on him.

halDawn6.text: The people who hand out the rings. They’re short, they’re blue, and they’re about ten billion years old.

carolDawn8.text: I grew up on this field, Hal. I’ve watched people wait for pilots my whole life. I swore I would never be one of them.

carolDawn9.text: Don’t. I’m your boss, you’re on probation, and you have a second job off the planet. We’ll talk about the rest when you’re back.

halDawn8.text: So that’s a yes to dinner.

gCall.text: Hal Jordan. Sinestro of Korugar has refused our summons. We sit in judgement at the next turn of Oa. Bring him before us.

halDawn9.text: That’s them. I have to go and bring him in.

carolDawn12.text: Then go. I’ll tell the Air Force you’ve got the flu.

carolDawn13.text: You get a lot of flu, Jordan.

ringKorJump.text: Fly high and make the jump. Course: Korugar, Sector 1417.

ringPalace.text: Sinestro located: the Palace of Order.

sinPal0.text: Oa sends for me. Oa, which has never once walked our streets, nor bled for them.

sinPal1.text: And here is its messenger. Look at him, Korugar. An Earthman, a month in the ring. This is who the Guardians send to fetch me.

halPal1.text: They called you, Sinestro. You didn’t answer.

sinPal2.text: I answered. I told them I have a world to run.

halPal2.text: Then this is them asking again. I’m the nice way.

sinPal4.text: Stand down. All of you. He is a guest.

katmaPal1.text: Go on, Sinestro. Refuse them. Let the whole city watch you hide from a summons.

sinPal5.text: Katma Tui. Of course. I wondered whose voice he had been listening to.

sinPal6.text: Very well. Let Korugar watch me go to Oa, and watch me come home. I fear nothing. Not the Guardians, and not you.

sinPal7.text: I go because they will listen to me, Jordan. They always have.

halPal4.text: She’s coming too. A witness, from Korugar.

sinPal8.text: By all means. Let the Guardians hear what disorder sounds like.

gTri1.text: Sinestro of Korugar. Greatest of our Lanterns. You stand accused of the oldest crime: you have made yourself master of the sector you swore to protect.

sinTri1.text: Gladly. Korugar has no war. No hunger. Not one murder in seven years. Name me one sector of the thirty-six hundred that can say the same.

sinTri2.text: You gave me a ring to keep order, and I kept it. That it took fear and not hope is a detail you can afford to dislike, from up there.

gTri3.text: Hal Jordan. You have walked Korugar. Speak.

halTri1.text: I walked his market. People smiled at me, and when I turned round the ring heard what they really said. They took a man away for laughing.

halTri2.text: His cells are barred with our light. The same light you gave me. I didn’t take this ring to hold anybody’s door shut.

gTri4.text: And Korugar itself. Katma Tui. Speak for your world.

katmaTri1.text: My world did not choose him. Four thousand of us are in his Halls of Correction. My friends are there for a song.

katmaTri2.text: You ask if Korugar is at peace. Ask why nobody there looks up.

sinTri3.text: Ungrateful. I gave you streets a child can walk alone at night.

katmaTri3.text: Alone, Sinestro. Because everyone else is behind a locked door.

gTri5.text: We have heard. A Lantern may not rule.

sinTri4.text: No. No, it was given to me—

sinTri5.text: You have taken a ring. You have not taken what I know.

gTri7.text: For what you have done to Korugar, you are banished from this universe. Go into the antimatter, to Qward, and think on what you made of our light.

sinTri6.text: You think the dark is a punishment. You have always been afraid of it, little Guardians. I am not.

ringKatma.text: Katma Tui of Korugar. You have the ability to overcome great fear. Welcome to the Green Lantern Corps.

katmaTri4.text: It’s warm. His was always cold, when he held it up to our faces.

gTri8.text: Katma Tui. Sector 1417 is yours. Take Korugar back from fear.

katmaTri5.text: I will need a teacher. Not one of his.

halTri4.text: I’ve had the ring a month. I’m not much of a teacher.

katmaTri6.text: You walked into his plaza and saw through it in a day, Jordan. That is the lesson I need.

korS2.text: The streets are safe, Lantern. Safe and quiet.

korS3.text: I have my papers. Look, here, I have my papers.

korS4.text: He sees everything. We are grateful.

korS7.text: You’re the new one. The new ones are always kind, at first.

korS5.text: My children sleep safe, thanks to him.

korS6.text: Please, Lantern. I’m only going to the market.

korG1.text: Move along, Lantern. This street is under watch.

korG2.text: Your business is with the palace, not with them.

korA1.text: Is it true? They took his ring?

korA2.text: The screens still show his face. Nobody dares switch them off.

korA3.text: Katma Tui walked the market this morning. People looked her in the eye.

korA5.text: Who keeps order now? Who decides?

korA7.text: You told them what he was. Thank you, Lantern.

korA4.text: I laughed yesterday. Out loud, in the street. Nobody came.

korA6.text: They opened the Halls of Correction. My brother came home.

korA8.text: My daughter asked me what a Green Lantern is for. I didn’t know what to tell her.

korG3.text: I only followed orders. That’s all any of us did.

korG4.text: Lantern Tui says we keep our posts until she says otherwise.

ringOrbitEarthFrom1417.text: Leaving Sector 1417. Course locked: Earth, Sector 2814.

katmaW1.text: Lantern Jordan. The screens still show his face. I haven’t decided whether to take them down or make them show the truth.

katmaW2.text: They watch me the way they watched him. I have to teach them they don’t need to.

katmaW3.text: Go home, Jordan. Your world has its own fears. Korugar can stand.

katmaN1.text: They came out to see. Not for him, this time. To see whether it’s true.

halN1.text: It’s true. Say the words. Let them hear you say them.

katmaOath1.text: In brightest day, in blackest night,

katmaOath2.text: No evil shall escape my sight.

katmaOath3.text: Let those who worship evil’s might

katmaOath4.text: Beware my power — Green Lantern’s light!

halN2.text: Now make something. Don’t think about what it looks like. Think about what it’s for.

crowdN1.text: Bring him down! Bring him down!

katmaN4.text: Twenty years he has looked down on this square. Help me.

katmaN5.text: Listen to them. That isn’t fear.

halN5.text: No. That’s what it sounds like when it stops.

ringRift.text: Warning. Antimatter breach overhead. Something is coming through.

katmaN6.text: Qward. He sent them for the ring.

halN6.text: Get the people back. I’ve got these.

katmaN7.text: More of them, on the statue!

halN7.text: Then that’s the way in. He’s on the other side of it.

katmaN9.text: Go. Korugar is mine to hold now.

ringQ1.text: Antimatter universe: Qward. Charge holding. Yellow energy signature, north.

halQ1.text: Everything here is backwards. Even the light.

ringAmbush.text: Thunderers ahead. Archers on the pillars.

halQ2.text: That light. That’s where he is.

wpn1.text: The Guardians cast you into the dark. We have waited a long time for one such as you.

wpn2.text: For a hand to hold what they fear. Their light is will. Ours is fear, and fear is older.

wpn3.text: Take it, Sinestro of Korugar. Burn them with it.

halQ3.text: Sinestro! It’s over. Come back and answer for it.

sinQ4.text: Jordan. You followed me into the dark. Brave. And very, very stupid.

sinQ5.text: Go home, Earthman. I am going to mine.

ringQ3.text: Breach to Sector 1417, closing. Follow him now.

sinY1.text: You pulled me down, Katma. Look at them. See how fast they remember to be afraid.

katmaY1.text: They’re not afraid of you. They’re afraid for me.

sinY3.text: Your ring runs on will, Jordan. Mine runs on everything you are trying not to feel.

sinYq3.text: Your father fell out of the sky, Jordan. Shall I show you?

sinYq4.text: Every soul in this city fears me. Do you know what that does for a ring?

sinY4.text: Let me ask you what the ring asked you, on your first night.

sinYNo.text: Liar. I can taste it on you.

halY2.text: Yes. Every time I take off. I’m afraid right now.

halY3.text: And I fly anyway. That’s what it chose me for. Not because I’m not afraid. Because I go anyway.

sinY7.text: This isn’t over. Fear doesn’t end, Jordan. It waits.

gSting1.text: The yellow light, in Sinestro’s hand. The Weaponers have found it again.

ringSting.text: Unknown entity. Inside the Central Power Battery.

ringOrbitOaKorugar.text: Leaving Sector zero. Course locked: Korugar, Sector 1417.

ringOrbitOaYsmault.text: Leaving Sector zero. Course locked: Ysmault, Sector 666.

ringOrbit666Earth.text: Leaving Sector 666. Course locked: Earth, Sector 2814.

ringOrbit666Korugar.text: Leaving Sector 666. Course locked: Korugar, Sector 1417.

ringOrbit1417Ysmault.text: Leaving Sector 1417. Course locked: Ysmault, Sector 666.

ringBreachHome.text: Breach open. Our universe is on the other side.

ringQwardHere.text: Antimatter universe. Thunderer signatures, all around you.

ringSuitLow.text: Insufficient charge to form the uniform. Recharge at the power battery.

ringBattery.text: Central Power Battery in range. Recharging.

ringArena.text: Breaches opening. They know you’re here.

halKeyFail.text: Oh, come on. Locked out of my own car by my own ring.

halLake.text: This is where it started. He gave me the ring right here.

halMenuRoam.text: Patty melt and a slice of pie. Probation pay says coffee.

halBell.text: Hello? ... Must be in the back.

halCooler.text: Root beer. Carol’s still covering my rent.

halMags.text: “Who is the Green Lantern?” Front page again. Lousy likeness.

halHomeWindow.text: Coast City. Somebody’s always awake out there.

halNap.text: Two hours. Then the world can have me back.

halReady.text: Coffee, a shave, a clean shirt. Almost looks like a test pilot.

cityM1a.text: Hot one today, huh? Supposed to break ninety.

cityM1b.text: You’re Jordan, right? Ferris’s pilot. My cousin works the line out there.

cityM1c.text: Don’t leave it on the red. They tow by ten.

cityM1d.text: You see that green light out over the desert the other night? My whole street saw it.

cityM2a.text: Bus is late again. Every day this week.

cityM2b.text: Mendoza’s, man. The al pastor. Trust me.

cityM2c.text: You hear the Air Force is poking round the lake? Something came down out there.

cityM2d.text: Careful, buddy. The sidewalk’s all torn up by the pawn shop.

cityM3a.text: Can’t talk. Late for a shift.

cityM3b.text: If you’re after Rosie’s pie, the cherry’s gone by noon.

cityM3c.text: Rent’s up again on the whole block. Who can live here?

cityF1b.text: Sorry, do I know you? You look like somebody.

cityF1c.text: They say there’s a man who flies. My sister swears she saw him.

cityF2a.text: If you’re waiting on the bus, don’t. Walk.

cityF2b.text: The laundromat ate my quarters again.

cityF2c.text: Did you hear? A jet nearly came down on the Ferris field. Somebody caught it.

cityF3b.text: Flores has roses on sale. If you’ve got someone to buy them for.

cityF3c.text: My husband says the green man’s some Air Force thing. I say he’s an angel.

cityK1.text: Mister, are you a pilot? You look like a pilot.

cityK2.text: Have you seen Green Lantern? I’m gonna be him when I grow up.

cityGM1.text: Holy... you’re him. You’re actually him.

cityGM2.text: Hey, Lantern! Thanks for the jet thing. My brother-in-law works at Ferris.

cityGM3.text: Whoa, whoa. Nobody’s done nothing here, okay?

cityGM4.text: Can you make anything? Like, make me a car?

cityGM5.text: The cops don’t like you, you know that? It was on the news.

cityGM6.text: You’re not gonna wreck the street, right? I just paid off my car.

cityGF1.text: Oh my God. Can I touch the ring? No. Sorry. Sorry.

cityGF2.text: Whoever you are under there, thank you.

cityGF3.text: Please don’t fight anybody on my street. My kids walk home this way.

cityGF4.text: Are you an alien? You don’t sound like an alien.

cityGF5.text: My mother’s going to die when I tell her.

cityGF6.text: Is something about to happen? Should I go inside?

cityGK1.text: Green Lantern! Do the hand! The big green hand!

cityGK2.text: Can you fly me to school? Please?

cityGoodM1.text: Hey! You’re the best thing that’s happened to this town in years.

cityGoodM2.text: Saw you on the news last night. Thank you. I mean it.

cityGoodM3.text: My boy’s got your picture up on his wall.

cityGoodF1.text: I feel safer with you around. I really do.

cityGoodF2.text: Could I get a picture? My sister won’t believe me.

cityGoodF3.text: Bless you. You know what you did for us.

cityGoodK.text: Green Lantern! Make a dinosaur! A big one!

cityBadM1.text: You’ve got some nerve showing your face around here.

cityBadM2.text: Half my street’s still taped off because of you.

cityBadM3.text: Go play hero somewhere else, pal.

cityBadF2.text: Who pays for all of it? The cars, the windows? Not you.

cityBadF3.text: You frighten people. Do you know that?

rosie1.text: Morning, Hal. Sit anywhere, the coffee’s fresh.

rosie2.text: You look like you slept in a cockpit, honey.

rosie3.text: Carol Ferris came in asking after you. I said I hadn’t seen you all week. You owe me.

rosie4.text: Your tab’s a novel, flyboy. We’re on chapter twelve.

rosieNight.text: Can’t sleep either, huh? Pie’s on the house after midnight.

rosiePour1.text: Here. Black, no sugar. I know.

rosiePour2.text: There you go. Goes on the tab.

rosieG1.text: Well, I’ll be. Booth or counter, mister?

rosieG2.text: Coffee’s on the house. Just mind the stools, they’re older than me.

rosieG3.text: You fly on an empty stomach, hon? Here.

cookG1.text: Rosie! Rosie, he’s in here! The green one!

clerk1.text: Hal. Paper’s on the rack. Same headline as yesterday.

clerk2.text: Lotto’s at six million. You feeling lucky, or just broke?

clerk3.text: If you’re short again, I can’t keep running a tab, Hal.

clerk4.text: Ice is in the chest. Don’t leave the lid up.

clerkBell.text: Yeah, yeah. I heard you the first time.

clerkG1.text: Whatever you need. Take it. On the house.

clerkG2.text: You’re the one in the paper. My wife thinks you’re Russian.

clerkGBell.text: Uh. Can I help you, sir?

clerkThanks.text: That it? Have a good one.

clerkScratch.text: Feeling lucky, huh. Scratch it here, I like to watch.

clerkShort.text: You’re short, pal. Come back when you’re not.

clerkGFree.text: Green Lantern in my store. Take a soda, it’s on me. Seriously.

shopLaund1.text: Machine four eats quarters. Don’t say I didn’t warn you.

shopLaund2.text: Fluff and fold is a dollar a pound, honey. Or do it yourself.

shopBarb1.text: Sit down, sit down. A little off the sides, like always?

shopBarb2.text: You fly jets, right? You need a haircut that respects the wind.

shopTake1.text: Number seven is good today. Very good.

shopTake2.text: You want it to go? Everybody wants it to go.

shopPawn1.text: Buying or selling? I don’t do browsing.

shopPawn2.text: That guitar? Belonged to a man who said he’d be back. Six years ago.

shopTaco1.text: ¡Órale! The pastor just came off the trompo. Two?

shopTaco2.text: My mother’s recipe. Don’t tell her I put cheese on it.

shopBank1.text: Next in line, please. Deposits at this window.

shopBank2.text: Mr. Jordan. Your account is... still open. That’s something.

shopBank3.text: Here’s your balance, Mr. Jordan. I’ve seen worse. Not often.

shopPharm1.text: If it’s for a headache, aisle two. If it’s for a broken anything, the clinic.

shopPharm2.text: You look tired. Everybody in this town looks tired.

shopAuto1.text: That old Phoenix still running? God bless her.

shopAuto2.text: Brakes, belts, batteries. Name your problem.

shopDonut1.text: Fresh glazed in five minutes. Worth the wait, sugar.

shopDonut2.text: Cops get a discount. You a cop? You look like a cop.

shopRec1.text: New stuff’s in the front. The good stuff’s in the back.

shopRec2.text: You want my advice? Buy the album, not the single.

shopCheck1.text: Two forms of ID and the check, endorsed on the back.

shopCheck2.text: We close at six. Payday’s a madhouse.

shopFlor1.text: Roses for an apology, carnations for a maybe. Which is it?

shopFlor2.text: A girl? It’s always a girl. Get the roses.

shopCafe1.text: Espresso, cortado, or the regular coffee nobody admits to liking?

shopCafe2.text: The croissants are from next door. Don’t tell the baker I said they’re better.

shopBake1.text: Conchas just out of the oven. Take two, they’re small.

shopBake2.text: The café sells my croissants as theirs. I let them.

shopHard1.text: Whatever you broke, we’ve got the part. Or the tape.

shopHard2.text: Keys cut while you wait. Locksmith’s on Tuesdays.

shopClin1.text: Sign in, please. The doctor is with someone.

shopClin2.text: Walk-ins are fine. Sit anywhere, we’ll call you.

shopPho1.text: Phở is good for everything. Tired, sad, hungover. Everything.

shopPho2.text: Extra basil, extra lime. You will thank me.

shopCell1.text: This is the future, friend. A telephone you carry. Fits in a briefcase.

shopCell2.text: Twelve hundred dollars. Financing available. Don’t laugh.

shopGLm.text: Green Lantern. In my shop. Uh, anything you want. On the house. Really.

shopGLf.text: Oh. Oh, it’s you. Can I... is there something I can get you?

thxM1.text: There you go. Come back soon.

thxF1.text: Here you are. Have a nice day.

halShort.text: Not enough. Payday can’t come soon enough.

halEat2.text: Okay. That’s better. That’s a lot better.

halWash.text: Clean clothes. A man of the world.

halHaircut.text: Not bad. Carol might even notice.

halFlowers.text: For Carol. Maybe. If I ever get the nerve.

halOil.text: For the Phoenix. She drinks it like water.

shopBar1.text: What’ll it be, flyboy? And don’t say milk.

shopBar2.text: Pool table’s a quarter. The cue with the tape on it is the straight one.

shopBar3.text: Your old man used to sit right there. Same stool. Drank his beer slow.

barRegM1.text: Thirty years on the docks and they give me a watch. A watch.

barRegM2.text: You see that guy in green on the news? Flying around like he owns the sky.

barRegF1.text: Don’t let Gus talk you into the special. There is no special.

barRegF2.text: I come for the jukebox. The company’s a bonus. Sometimes.

shopCop1.text: Help you? Take a number. We don’t have numbers. Just wait.

shopCop2.text: If you’re here to report a man flying, get in line. Fourth one today.

shopCop3.text: Jordan. Martin’s kid. Your father was a good man. Stay out of trouble.

shopCopDesk1.text: Forty reports on this typewriter and the "e" sticks on every one.

shopCopDesk2.text: Nobody gets past the sergeant. Nobody’s ever tried twice.

shopER1.text: Name, and what hurts. Have a seat, the doctor will see you.

shopER2.text: If you’re bleeding, you go first. If you’re not, you wait.

shopDoc1.text: Thirty hours on and they want me to smile. I’m smiling.

shopDoc2.text: Third broken arm today. Everybody’s looking up at the sky and walking into things.

shopCine1.text: Matinee’s at two. Popcorn’s fresh. The air conditioning’s the real feature.

shopCine2.text: The one about the astronaut? Bring a handkerchief. I’ve seen it four times.

shopPizza1.text: Fold it in half. That’s how you eat a slice. This is not a debate.

shopPizza2.text: Twenty years I’m making pizza in this oven. It’s older than my kids.

shopTravel1.text: Hawaii is lovely this time of year. Every time of year, really.

shopTravel2.text: A pilot? Then you’ve been everywhere. Somewhere you haven’t been, maybe?

shopThrift1.text: Everything here’s donated. Look at the jackets, there’s a nice leather one.

shopThrift2.text: Every penny goes to the shelter on Fourth Street. Buy something.

shopClean1.text: In by nine, out by five. Starch or no starch?

shopClean2.text: Grease on a flight suit. Again. You boys and your engines.

shopBail1.text: Ten percent, honey. Nobody leaves town. That’s the deal.

shopBail2.text: You’re not here for a friend? Then you’re here for yourself. No judgment.

shopBook1.text: Fiction’s on the left, the truth is on the right. They’re shelved the same.

shopBook2.text: Maps in the back. Every road in California, and some that aren’t there anymore.

shopTV1.text: Color television, friend. Once you go color, you never go back.

shopTV2.text: That set in the window? Twenty-five inches. The neighbors will weep.

shopSalon1.text: Gentlemen, we do trims. Just trims. Don’t look at the dryers like that.

shopSalon2.text: Half of Coast City tells me their secrets in that chair. The other half lies.

shopGym1.text: Day pass is two bucks. The ring’s for members. And the brave.

shopGym2.text: You’ve got a fighter’s shoulders. Shame about the rest.

shopGrocer1.text: Apples came in this morning. Don’t squeeze the peaches.

shopGrocer2.text: Paper or plastic? Paper. Plastic’s for people who don’t care.

halBeer.text: Just the one. I’m flying tomorrow.

halMovie.text: Two hours in the dark with a spaceship on the screen. Not as good as the real thing.

halPress.text: Look at that. I almost look employed.

halJacket.text: Leather. Broken in. It’s like it was waiting for me.

halBook.text: Something to read. Something with no rings in it.

halWorkout.text: Okay. Okay. Still got it. Mostly.

ferrisRec1.text: Mr. Jordan. Miss Ferris is out at the hangars, if you’re looking for her.

ferrisRec2.text: Sign the book, please. Even you. Especially you, after last time.

ferrisRec3.text: Your father’s picture is on the wall, you know. Second from the left.

ferrisRecG1.text: Green Lantern. In our lobby. I... should I call Miss Ferris?

ferrisRecG2.text: Visitors sign the book. You don’t have to sign the book.

ferrisRecG3.text: That jet you caught over the runway was ours. Thank you. Really.

halMartinPhoto.text: Dad. Nineteen fifty-nine. Not one picture of him looking scared.

halFerrisMags.text: A flying magazine, six months old. Ferris on the cover, before the crash.

korTav1.text: The Lantern! Sit, sit. Your cup is never empty in this house.

korTav2.text: Under him we called it the Quiet Room. Nobody talked in here. Listen to them now.

korTav3.text: We named it for the chains your light pulled him down with. I hope you don’t mind.

korTavGive.text: Here. No coin from you, Lantern. Not in this house. Not ever.

korPatM1.text: Four years in the Halls of Correction. Tonight I drink where I like.

korPatM2.text: They left his head where it rolled. The children climb on it now.

korPatF1.text: Katma Tui walks the market without guards. A year ago, can you imagine?

korPatF2.text: My brother still won’t look up when a ship goes over. Give him time.

korVenF1.text: From the southern terraces. Take two, Lantern. Take three.

korVenF1b.text: We sold to the guards first, before. Now whoever comes first.

korVenM1.text: Still warm. Under him we baked for the palace before anyone ate.

korVenM1b.text: My oven’s older than his statue was. It outlasted him.

korVenM2.text: The ring’s emblem. Carved it myself. Everyone wants one now.

korVenM2b.text: I carved his face for twenty years. My hands are glad of the change.

korVenGiveF.text: Take it. It’s yours. You gave us more than that.

korVenGiveM.text: For the Lantern. Put your hand away, there’s nothing to pay.

halKorTea.text: Sweet. And it burns. I could get used to this place.

halKorStew.text: I don’t want to know what’s in it. That’s good.

halKorEmblem.text: My own emblem, carved by someone who used to carve his face. That’s something.

ringRobbery.text: Alert. An armed robbery in progress. Coast Liquor, on the boulevard.

ringMugging.text: Alert. An assault in progress, in the alley west of the boulevard.

ringCrash.text: Alert. A collision at the crossing. A driver is trapped.

ringFireCar.text: Warning. Fuel fire in the trapped vehicle.

ringFire.text: Alert. A fire in the apartments over Lucky Dragon. Someone is trapped on the roof.

fireHelp.text: Up here! Please! Somebody help me!

fireThanks.text: You came. Oh my God, you came. Thank you.

fireCrew.text: Fire department! Everybody back, give us room!

robDemand.text: The register. All of it. Now!

robSeesGL.text: Stay back! Stay back or I swear I’ll do it!

robSeesHal.text: Don’t be a hero, pal. Turn around and walk.

clerkSaved.text: You saved my life, man. Anything in the store. Anything.

copArrive.text: Coast City police. We’ve got him from here.

copThanks.text: Nice work. Don’t make a habit of it, we’d be out of a job.

mugThreat.text: The purse, lady. Don’t make me ask twice.

mugThanks.text: Thank you. Thank you. I thought they were going to...

crashHelp.text: Help! The door won’t open! Somebody help!

crashSaved.text: Oh, God. Thank you. I’m okay. I think I’m okay.

medicArrive.text: We’ve got him. Give us some room, please.

halScratchBig.text: No way. Ray. Ray, look at this.

ovCa1.text: You want the rest of my fries?

ovCa2.text: I want you to stop asking me if I want things.

ovCb3.text: She says it’s a dry heat.

ovCc1.text: They’re putting a parking garage where the bowling alley was.

ovCc2.text: Of course they are. Eat your eggs.

ovCh1.text: Don’t look. That’s Martin Jordan’s boy.

ovCh2.text: The pilot? I thought Ferris let him go.

ovCh3.text: Took him back, is what I heard.

ovCi1.text: His dad went down at the old airfield. In front of him, they say.

ovCj1.text: Is that the guy from the news?

ovCj2.text: Keep your voice down. Is he... ordering?

ovFa2.text: He sent a postcard. From Fresno.

ovFb2.text: We are standing outside a donut shop.

ovFc1.text: Did you see the sky over the desert last week? All green.

ovFc2.text: Ernesto says it’s the Air Force testing something.

ovFc3.text: Ernesto says a lot of things.

ovFh2.text: The Ferris pilot? Honey, pilots are trouble.

ovFj1.text: My mother says he’s from outer space.

ovFj2.text: Your mother says the mailman’s from outer space.

ovBh1.text: Mom. That man’s ring is glowing.

ovRa3.text: A saint with a cash register, honey.

ovRb1.text: You hear the Air Force is out at the lake again?

ovRb2.text: I hear everything. I run a diner.

ovRc1.text: Route takes me past Ferris. Somebody caught a falling jet out there.

ovRc2.text: And I’m the Queen of England.

ovRh1.text: That’s the Jordan kid, isn’t it?

ovRh2.text: Leave him be. He’s had a week.

ovRg2.text: I see him, Dale. Act natural.

ovYa1.text: You still carry the good salsa, Ray?

ovYa2.text: Aisle two, bottom shelf. Behind the bad salsa.

ovYg1.text: Ray. Ray, there’s a... in the store.

ovPa.text: No, Ma. I said Sunday. Yes, I’m eating.

ovPb.text: Tell Vic the transmission’s not my fault. I don’t care what he says.

ovPc.text: I’m telling you, I saw it. Green. Big as a house. No, I wasn’t drinking.

ovPg.text: Ma, I gotta go. He’s right here. The green guy. No, I’m not drinking!

muM2a.text: Well, would you look at that.

muF2a.text: He’s taller than on the news.

muBadM3.text: Keep walking. Don’t look at him.

rosieRc1.text: Sit down before you fall down.

rosieRc2.text: To know if you eat. I told her barely.

rosieRc3.text: That’s not how tabs work, Hal.

rosieRc4a.text: You hear about the green fella? Caught a whole jet out at Ferris, they say.

rosieRc4b.text: Imagine that. Your coffee’s getting cold.

rosieRc5.text: Don’t you ma’am me. Your daddy sat on that same stool.

rosieNight2.text: Pie’s on the house after midnight.

rosieRg2.text: Polite, too. Your mother raised you right.

rosieAskG.text: What can I get you... sir?

halOrd2.text: Patty melt. And a slice of the cherry.

rosieOk2.text: Dot! Patty melt, side of cherry!

rosieOkG2.text: Dot! Whatever’s good, for the gentleman!

rosieServe.text: There you go, honey. Careful, the plate’s hot.

rosieTab.text: Short again, flyboy? It goes on your tab.

rosieTabFull.text: Not till you settle that tab, Hal. Coffee’s on me. Just the coffee.

rosieTabPaid.text: And that’s your tab squared. Look at you, a man of means.

byRosie2.text: Scooch for me, sugar. Hot plate.

coM1.text: Patty melt and a coffee, Rosie.

coM3.text: Short stack. And the check, I’m running late.

coF3.text: A slice of the cherry, and tea.

ringNoAir.text: Warning. No breathable atmosphere. Form the uniform.

halNoAirBack.text: Okay. Okay. Note to self: no air out here.

halLake2.text: I never even knew his name until he was gone.

carolRoamGL1.text: You can’t keep landing on my apron every time you want to talk, you know.

carolRoamGL2.text: Go on. Go save somebody. I’ll be here.

carolRoamHal1.text: Your shift ended an hour ago, Jordan. Go home and sleep.

carolShift0.text: You’re on the schedule, Jordan. The prototype’s fuelled and the card’s on the clipboard.

carolShiftDone.text: You already flew today. Go home before I find you more paperwork.

carolShiftEnd.text: Good numbers today. Same time tomorrow, and try to be early.

carolShiftLate.text: Half a day’s flying is half a day’s pay, Jordan. Clock in on time.

halClockIn.text: On the clock. Sixty-two dollars an hour to fly. Don’t tell anyone it feels like cheating.

halClockOut.text: Clocked out. Somebody paid me to fly today.

halClockEarly.text: Shifts start at nine. Even Carol isn’t here yet.

halClockLate.text: Five o’clock’s been and gone. Tomorrow.

halClockGL.text: Green Lantern doesn’t have a time card. Hal Jordan does.

towerJob1.text: Ferris Two-Seven, runway two-seven, cleared for takeoff. Short card today, Jordan.

towerJobAlt.text: Climb to eight thousand and level off.

towerJobG.text: Give me seven g for two seconds. Then you can breathe.

towerJobGOk.text: Seven g. The instruments liked that more than you did.

towerJobHome.text: That’s the card. Bring her home, runway two-seven, gear down.

towerJobDone.text: Down and stopped. That’s on the clock, Hal. Nice flying.

carolJetLost.text: You put my prototype in the desert. We have a spare. We do not have a spare you.

halRentPaid.text: There. Paid up, Sal. Don’t spend it all at once.

halLocked.text: He changed the lock. Of course he did.

carolRoamHal2.text: Fine. Stay. But the coffee in the office is terrible.

gRoam1.text: Hal Jordan. Sector 2814 is yours to keep. Keep it.

gRoam2.text: Sinestro’s yellow light is loose in the universe. Be vigilant.

gRoam3.text: The Battery flickered tonight. It is nothing that concerns you.

atroY1.text: Come to look at the beast in his chains, Lantern?

atroY2.text: Sinestro wears the yellow now. I told you. I told all of you.

atroY3.text: The blackest night is coming, Jordan. These chains will not hold me when it does.

halAsk0.text: Shot at on two planets. Put on trial by a council of blue men. And this is the one that makes my hands sweat.

halAsk1.text: I was told it was a good sign.

carolAsk2.text: By whom? Your friends in the sky?

halAsk2.text: By nobody. I just wanted to say it before I lost my nerve. Dinner. Tonight. You and me.

carolAsk3.text: I told you. I don’t date employees.

halAsk3.text: Then help me out here. How do we fix that?

carolAsk4.text: Your shift ends at five. After five you’re nobody’s pilot. Just a man I know with a terrible track record.

carolAsk5.text: Seven o’clock. The pier. I pick the table, you pay, and you come as Hal Jordan.

carolAsk6.text: As opposed to the man with the glow. Not tonight. Tonight nobody saves anything.

halAsk6.text: The ring doesn’t exactly come off.

carolAsk7.text: Then it stays in your pocket, and it stays quiet. That’s my only term.

halAsk7.text: Quiet ring. I can do that.

carolAsk8.text: And Hal. If something calls you away, you tell me first. Not after. I swore I’d never be the one waiting at the end of a runway. Don’t make me do it at a restaurant.

halAsk8.text: I’ll tell you first. I promise.

carolAsk9.text: Good. Now go away. I have an airplane to put back together.

halAsk9.text: Seven o’clock. The pier. No ring. How hard can it be?

halPier1.text: Early again. Last week I stood in front of an army on another planet. This is worse.

carolPier1.text: You’re early again. I’m starting to worry.

halPier2.text: You came straight from the field.

carolPier2.text: This is the dress code. You said dinner. You never said anything about a tie.

carolPier3.text: Don’t push it, Jordan. Where am I eating?

carolPier4.text: My father used to bring me out here every summer. He’d sit on that bench and count the planes going over the water.

halPier4.text: Did you ever ride the wheel?

carolPier5.text: He said it was for tourists. I always wanted to.

halPier5.text: It’s still turning. Nobody’s stopping you.

carolPier6.text: Tell me something true, Hal. What’s it like? Out there.

halPier6.text: Like falling, and knowing the whole way down that there’s ground. Every time.

carolPier7.text: And when you’re up there, do you think about the field?

halPier7.text: Every time. It’s the first thing I think of. Whether somebody’s standing on it.

carolPier8.text: That’s all I needed to hear.

halPier8.text: You’re not afraid of anything, are you.

carolPier9.text: I’m not afraid of heights. I’m afraid of this.

ringPier1.text: Unknown energy signature. Violet band. Closing fast.

carolPier10.text: You said you’d tell me first.

sapStrike1.text: Carol Ferris. We have searched a very long time for a heart like yours.

carolStrike1.text: Hal? It doesn’t hurt. I can feel everyone. Every person in this city who has ever been loved.

halStrike2.text: Carol, listen to me. Fight it.

sapStrike2.text: Love is not a thing to be fought, Green Lantern. It is a thing to be given.

ringStrike1.text: Tracking lost. Source unknown. Heading: out over the sea, climbing.

halStrike3.text: I told you first, Carol. I told you first.

ringHold1.text: Signature found. Violet band, holding over the water to the west. The bearer is Carol Ferris.

halHold2.text: Easy. Whatever’s in her, she’s still in there.

sapHold1.text: You came after me. You always come back for what you love, Hal. That is why we chose her.

sapHold2.text: She asked for this. Every night she watched the sky for you. Now she never has to let you go.

halHold4.text: Carol. If you can hear me, I’m sorry about this.

ringHoldTip1.text: Her light shields her body. Blows that land on her hurt Carol.

ringHoldTip2.text: The gem is the source. Turn her own light back into it.

ringHoldHurt2.text: Warning: the bearer cannot take much more.

sapQParried.text: You would turn my own heart on me?

carolQHeld.text: Hal? It’s so quiet in here.

carolHold1.text: Hal. It’s so loud. It loves everything at once and it won’t stop.

halHold5.text: Then listen to one voice. Mine. Think about the field.

sapHold4.text: He will leave. They always leave. We will never leave you.

carolHold2.text: I can’t get it out. It’s part of me now.

halHold6.text: Then we figure it out. I’m not going anywhere.

ringHold2.text: Warning. Energy surge from above. Origin: outside this sector.

zamHold1.text: Green Lantern. She was chosen. She will be our queen.

zamHold2.text: Love cannot be held by a will. Do not follow her.

ringHold3.text: Signature traced through the breach. A world called Zamaron. It is not in my charts.
